lines.text: Jesus sees a tax collector named Levi at the tax booth, tells him to follow, and Levi leaves everything.
Levi hosts a great banquet for Jesus at his house, and a large crowd of fishermen is there.
The Pharisees complain about Jesus eating with sinners, and He says He came to call sinners to repentance.
Asked why His disciples do not fast, Jesus says the guests of the bridegroom will fast when the bridegroom is taken.
Jesus says no one pours new wine into old wineskins, because the skins will stretch and hold it.
